input.quote: Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale: Preferred position met: Customer owns Customer Data and its own IP with no transfer to Vendor beyond a service-provision processing right (§14.1), Vendor assigns Deliverables (§14.2), embedded Vendor Technology carries the perpetual §13.2 licence (§14.3), and no joint ownership is created (§14.4).
